data.title: EDGE rallies, but sentiment remain neutral – What’s raising investor caution?
data.description:
EdgeX [EDGE], the native token of the decentralized trading application, has continued to see major price swings, with cumulative gains of over 11% in the past day.

At first glance, the rally remains optimistic, and the tendency for a continued swing remains the broader outlook. However, data shows that the difference in capital between long and short positions is not so far apart.

Capital pull doesn’t exist

Liquidation heatmap analysis shows that limited liquidity across EDGE’s price range leaves room for either an upward move or a downtrend.

The heatmap analysis highlights areas on the chart where there are likely to be potential buy orders (below the price) and sell orders (above the price), which often act as magnets that pull the price.

The 3-month heatmap shows a very limited cluster of liquidity across the market, leaving EDGE without a cluster-driven push.

In addition to this, the gap between long and short liquidated capital remains minimal, in a way that does not particularly suggest that the long trend is dominating.

CoinGlass shows that total liquidations in the past day amounted to roughly $47,580, with short liquidations at $23,790 and long liquidations reaching $23,790.

The narrow gap shows neither side’s dominance, as short positions would have lost significantly more capital if the broader trend were bullish.

Capital flow still shows weakness

There is still some level of apparent weakness in the market, especially linked to capital outflows in the perpetual market and weak demand in the Spot market.

The Perpetual Market Netflow shows that there has been more net capital outflow than inflow, signifying that there has been more profit-taking or that traders are pulling their capital out of the market.

The trend has been observed across a long stretch in the perpetual market. In the last 7 days alone, there has been a cumulative netflow of -$2.27 million, following the sale of $61.85 million worth of EDGE tokens in the market.

Likewise, it’s a similar trend in the Spot market with minimal demand. In the past 24 hours, the Spot Netflow was around -$51,000, following the purchase of $1.35 million worth of the asset in the market.

Demand has remained slim and has continued to show that investors in the market do not have a convincing bullish outlook for the price.

It’s a non-decisive market

It’s a non-decisive market as it is, with sentiment analytics showing a neutral reading.

The neutral reading implies that there is a tussle among investors over whether the price is fair or correctly valued. This type of dispute, especially when the price is rallying, does not support the bullish trend.

This remains similar to the earlier outlook, with liquidated capital remaining slim and closely balanced. Ultimately, investors need to exercise caution until a clear directional bias forms.

Final Summary

  • EDGE has gained over 11% in the past day, but long and short liquidations remain closely balanced.

  • Persistent capital outflows and weak Spot demand keep the market indecisive despite EDGE’s recent rally.

data.title: SecondFI reveals asset recovery tool following June’s Cardano wallet exploit
data.description:
SecondFI, a self-custody neofinance platform, has come up with an asset recovery tool after the $2 million exploit that happened in the month of June. The tool is designed to allow users affected by its security incident to recover their assets.

However, the tool is not in full swing yet, as the company is taking a staged approach to make sure the recovery mechanism itself is secure before releasing it publicly.

What’s SecondFI’s plan of action?

For this, SecondFi has commissioned an independent security review of the technology behind it and plans to conduct another audit of the smart contract that will ultimately handle the recovery process.

But before this, SecondFi had already identified that the 374 Cardano wallet exploit was caused by a deterministic nonce derivation flaw in its software signer.

This allowed attackers to mathematically reconstruct private keys from public blockchain data after affected addresses signed transactions.

How is zkSecurity helping SecondFi?

On the 3rd of August 2026, SecondFi hired zkSecurity to independently audit its proof-tool repository. The repository uses zero-knowledge proofs (ZKPs) that allow an affected user to prove that they control a particular Cardano [ADA] wallet credential.

The interesting part here is that the user can prove their control without revealing their seed phrase, private key, or wallet derivation path.

Additionally, the system is optimized to run directly in a web browser. As a result, it allows users to generate proofs locally instead of sending sensitive wallet information to a remote server.

Issues identified and fixed

As of now, according to the audit report, zkSecurity has identified two high-severity issues in upstream code. Notably, SecondFi has fixed both the issues. Meanwhile, zkSecurity has also reviewed and tested the fixes, confirming they have been resolved.

At the same time, the audit also found two low-severity issues in SecondFi’s own repository, which remain open but were assessed as not practically exploitable.

While these issues have not been fixed yet, the findings do not necessarily mean the recovery tool is unsafe.

That said, SecondFi expects the asset recovery tool to be launched in the coming weeks. However, this solely depends on the completion of the recovery smart contract audit and final production checks.

Final Summary

  • SecondFi has commissioned an independent security review of the technology behind it.
  • The firm also hired zkSecurity to independently audit its proof-tool repository.

data.title: Filecoin breaks $1 as volume explodes – Can bulls sustain FIL’s rally?
data.description:
Filecoin [FIL] broke out of a month-long range, pushing the altcoin above $1 for the first time since May. At the press time, FIL’s price surged by 20.1%, up to $0.9685, when it went over the $0.87 resistance, which previously blocked attempts to create a rally.

The surge was short-lived but pushed the price up to $1.03 before falling back down to around the $0.97 mark. The 24-hour trading volume also skyrocketed by 1026% alongside the price rally, up to $396.66 million.

This indicates that participation was up significantly during this time frame.

However, RSI stood at 78.05, which indicated an overbought territory. The resulting pullback from $1.03 towards $0.90 may be due to some early sellers locking in their profits.

That leaves $0.87 as the key level for the breakout. Holding above it would show buyers have absorbed the old resistance and could support another move toward $1.03. Losing it would weaken that demand and raise the risk of FIL falling back into its previous range.

Can network growth support FIL?

Filecoin’s breakout is further evidence of the way traders are starting to view Filecoin’s fundamentals.

A recent Solstice proposal may have added some credence to this new trend by focusing on one of Filecoin’s most publicized issues. This has been the bottleneck associated with the approval process for DataCaps.

The Solstice upgrade would tie block reward payments directly to verified transactional payments. Therefore, this implies that there would be a direct relationship between FIL’s economic model and real-world network utilization.

However, current FVM activity remains modest, with about 1,337 daily active addresses and DeFi TVL standing at $3.1 million.

This suggests the rally is pricing in future growth rather than strong usage today. Solstice strengthens that outlook, but rising network activity will be needed to sustain FIL’s breakout.

FIL’s rally puts $1 in focus

FIL’s breakout is now testing the psychological $1 level after the price reached $1.0299 before pulling back to $0.9685. The move has attracted fresh derivatives positioning, with open interest rising toward $284 million around the advance.

Futures volume also ran about 10 times higher than spot activity, showing that leverage is playing a major role in the push. That strength could help FIL clear $1, but it also raises the risk of sharper swings if traders begin taking profits.

Meanwhile, the former $0.87 ceiling has already held as support once, making it the key level beneath the rally. Holding $0.87 would keep the breakout structure intact and leave $1 within reach.

A sustained break above $1 could extend momentum, while losing $0.87 would weaken the move.

Final Summary

  • Filecoin broke above $0.87 as volume surged 1,026% as the price pushed past $1.
  • FIL needs to hold $0.87 and sustain demand for the breakout to continue.

data.title: Bitcoin defends $76K as sellers dominate – Could BTC stage another reversal?
data.description:
On the 11th of September, Bitcoin [BTC] fell to a low of $76,046. Just an hour and a half later, BTC had rallied 5.05% to reach a high of $79,890. This kind of swift, intense volatility hunted down both long and short liquidations.

The seemingly resurgent bulls were stopped in their tracks. Over the weekend, BTC consolidated between $76.5k and $77.5k. In recent trading hours, Bitcoin once again breached the upper boundary, but it is unclear if it will fall lower once again.

The upcoming week could see more BTC volatility

The Federal Reserve and the Bank of Japan are about to provide back-to-back policy decisions, making this week a pivotal one for markets. There is an 85% probability of a rate hike, and the markets have likely priced it in.

A 1.25% BOJ increase is expected, too. The real question is how hawkish both central banks sound after the decision, wrote XWIN Japan on CryptoQuant.

A rise in U.S. yields and yen appreciation would be particularly risky for Bitcoin. Such tight liquidity conditions could lead to investors cutting risk in crypto.

Will the fearful market conditions see another BTC reversal?

The 30-day sum of the Funding Rates on Binance was aggregated this way to make spotting a trend easier. The bearish consensus earlier this year saw some of the most bearish derivatives sentiment on Binance. Yet, the rally in May that reached $82,850 used this build-up of short positions as fuel.

Analyst Darkfost wrote that this kind of bearish consensus has tended to mark the end of a Bitcoin correction. In the months since then, Funding Rates have recovered from extreme bearishness.

The build-up of optimism has to be accompanied by steady spot demand to drive the next bull run.

Well-known analyst Joao Wedson used the monthly CVD chart of Bitcoin to understand buy and sell pressure on a monthly basis and how BTC prices react to it. The metric resets every month. At the time of writing, September was seller-dominated. However, it does not automatically yield a bearish bias.

If BTC manages to hold on to key supports, such as $76k, while the monthly CVD is deeply negative, it would mean passive (limit order) buys have absorbed the aggressive selling.

Final Summary

  • Bitcoin is likely to have a volatile trading week ahead, even though the market has priced in an 86.5% rate hike chance.
  • The derivatives and monthly CVD data highlighted how Bitcoin optimism has been building since May, but strong buying pressure has to come in to keep the recovery alive.

data.title: Solana expands tokenized equities as SOL tests $102.50 – Can it break higher?
data.description:
As trading activity grows to rival major venues, Solana’s tokenized equity markets are starting to attract attention.

In light of this, tokenized stocks on Solana [SOL] generated more than $200 million in volume. Surprisingly, these volumes exceed those associated with tokenized equities listed at both NASDAQ and NYSE, in excess of $100 million.

Notably, Raydium [RAY] captured about 70% of that activity, as such, representing the primary source of liquidity behind the growth. The comparison is narrower than it first appears. This is because it covers tokenized equities rather than the full stock market.

However, even with such a narrow scope, the size of the increase reflects the rapid pace of the emergence of on-chain stock trading. As more tokenized equities gain liquidity, Solana could become increasingly important for this emerging market.

Solana expands its tokenized-equity market

Against that backdrop, Solana’s tokenized-equity market is also expanding rapidly. As a result, this expansion gives traders a growing pool of assets to trade. Tokenized-equity supply reached a record $684 million last week, marking a 47% increase in just three weeks.

Increased amounts of capital are being represented through tokenized equities and ETFs as well. The expansion also comes from several issuers rather than one platform. xStocks, Ondo, Backpack Securities, Sunrise, Superstate, and Securitize have all launched stock products on Solana.

In total, these platforms offer over 100 different types of tokenized equities and ETFs, widening the market beyond a handful of assets.

This may create conditions that will allow for increased trading volume. However, there still needs to be substantial increases in trading volumes relative to new supply coming into the market.

SOL tests the $102.50 barrier

Meanwhile, Solana continues trading in a wide consolidation after its sharp August rally. The current price is currently near the midpoint of this trading range at approximately $101.48.

SOL trades near $101.48 after recovering from the $97.50 area, where buyers recently stepped in. That lower boundary (purple line) provided support at each of the previous two rallies, hence remaining the key support beneath price.

This lower boundary, shown by the purple line, has repeatedly protected the range and remains the key support beneath the price. Above it is a key resistance at $102.50 (orange line) that has acted as the main pivot, rejecting several advances since late August.

A sustained break above it would signal that buyers are finally overcoming repeated resistance and could expose the upper $107.50 level, marked by the purple line, followed by $110.68.

Meanwhile, the teal zone around $74–$78 shows the base that preceded August’s rally. RSI at 49.46 suggests momentum has reset, leaving SOL positioned for a decisive move.

Final Summary

  • Solana expands tokenized equities as volume tops $200 million and supply hits $684 million.
  • SOL is testing $102.50 after recovering from $97.50 and needs to break higher to extend its rally.

data.title: BUILDon rallies as holders hit record 87,320 – Can B extend its gains?
data.description:
BUILDon [B] has delivered double-digit percentage gains in the past day at press time, as sentiment strengthened in the market. According to the analysis of price, a major contributor to its price trending higher has been the surge in its holder count this month.

Since September began, there have been an additional 160 new holders in the market, bringing the total to an all-time high of 87,320 holders, according to the press-time reading on CoinMarketCap.

The volume-price analysis also supports the present bullish trend in the market, with roughly a 39% surge in market volume, reaching over $17.3 million across the spot and perpetual markets.

A surge in volume and price at the same time suggests that there is strong momentum that could possibly guarantee a continued upward swing in price in the near term.

Perpetual market shows strength

Tracking the activities of investors in the perpetual market, there has been clear interest, suggesting a high chance that price could surge further.

The Funding Rate climbed to one of its highest levels of the month at 0.0179%, showing that traders positioned most of the capital in B’s perpetual contracts for a rally.

Presently, CoinGlass reported roughly $31 million worth of capital in B’s Open Interest, which represents the capital in BUILDon’s perpetual contracts. Roughly 15%, or $4.77 million, came in over the past 24 hours.

This implies that while price rallied, investors were funding B’s contracts with more capital as they bet on the upside in anticipation of a run in the near term.

What’s next for price

B’s recent rally comes after just breaching a resistance level of a descending channel pattern.

Descending channels are levels on the chart that are formed from declining parallel support and resistance lines. Price tends to oscillate between these levels when trading within them, with the upper level, or resistance, acting as a boundary.

The recent breakout rally means that there is strong bullish momentum. However, price needs to surge further, and subsequent candles need to remain above this level to confirm the rally.

Using the Aroon indicator, there is bullish momentum, although it does not yet represent a completely strong bullish trend. Currently, the Aroon Up is at 100%, while the Aroon Down, which is declining, is at 21%. Should the Aroon Down drop to 0% while the Aroon Up remains at 100%, then it would confirm a definitive bullish trend.

Likewise, the Money Flow Index (MFI) has been on the positive side while rising. When the MFI is in the positive region above 50, it implies that more capital is flowing into the asset and that buyers are stepping into the market to purchase it.

For now, there is a strong bullish outlook for B, though investors still need to watch for changes across these metrics.

Final Summary

  • BUILDon’s holder count reached an all-time high of 87,320 as volume surged 39% to over $17.3 million.
  • Rising Open Interest and a 0.0179% Funding Rate show traders are positioning for further upside.

data.title: Dogecoin price rises 3%—but $0.09 still stands in the way
data.description:
On Sunday, September 13, Dogecoin’s price surged by nearly 3% to reach $0.0848, continuing its recovery from the August lows.

While some analysts believe the memecoin may be forming a base for a more significant rebound, a familiar obstacle around $0.09 still stands before DOGE to gather enough support for a clear run to and move beyond $0.10.

Dogecoin attempts to leave its decline behind

DOGE traded as high as $0.08496 at the time of writing, with volume hitting 141.53 million tokens. Buyers have stepped in when it approached $0.08, keeping DOGE from returning to its recent lows.

The recent rise arrives after a difficult few months for Dogecoin, seeing it drop from above $0.11 in May and falling briefly to below $0.07 in August.

​That decline has slowed with DOGE mostly between $0.08 and $0.009. The tighter range is seen by some analysts as evidence that sellers are losing control. 

​The road to $0.10 remains difficult

The nearest test is between $0.088 and $0.09. DOGE has struggled around the level multiple times since the August rally, and buyers have not been able to keep its price above the level.

If it sees a successful move beyond $0.09, it would bring $0.10 back into view, but as it stands with the latest price, it would need to gain about 18% to reach that level.

Other analysts have identified more challenging targets of $0.176 or $0.279, but these projections still require DOGE to breach $0.10 and carry its recovery.

DOGE is now getting to look a bit more steady as it climbs, with buying strength evenly dispersed among the price’s range without unusual bursts. Once under $0.08, DOGE would start looking less healthy from a recovery perspective as our focus moves to low prices.

Final Summary

  • The Dogecoin price rose 2.96% to $0.0848, continuing its recovery from August.
  • First, DOGE will need to break the resistance near $0.09 before it can target $0.10.

data.title: Zcash: Will $13.65M whale buying push ZEC price toward $1,500?
data.description:
Zcash whale accumulation outlook strengthened, with a $13.65 million position complementing aggressive spot-market buying throughout the latest price recovery.

According to Onchain Lens, one whale accumulated roughly 12.87K ZEC, worth around $13.65 million, from four major exchanges over the past week. 

Notably, the purchases originated from Binance, OKX, Kraken, and Gate, reflecting accumulation across several liquidity platforms. The whale later transferred the 12.86K ZEC into a fresh wallet, completing the broader accumulation sequence. 

Therefore, the activity removed a sizable position outside the exchanges where the whale initially acquired it. Besides, the accumulation also arrived as ZEC attempted to stabilize after its latest price pullback. 

Spot buyers back the whale activity

Additionally, whale accumulation activity did not stand alone, as the broader spot-market activity supported the accumulation picture.

The Spot Taker CVD remained taker-buy dominant, providing another demand element alongside the whale accumulation. Generally, this metric usually tracks whether aggressive market buyers or sellers control the executed spot volume over the measured period.

The buyer dominance implied that the market participants increasingly crossed the spread to acquire ZEC rather than awaiting lower prices. Crucially, such activity broadened the demand picture beyond one whale’s purchases across the centralized exchanges.

The whale accumulation reflected large-holder conviction, while Spot Taker CVD on the broader end highlighted aggressive buying across the spot market. 

Combined, both developments implied that the bulls actively absorbed the available ZEC during the recent price volatility. 

Mining economics attracted greater participation

Meanwhile, stronger network economics provided another support component to Zcash’s improving fundamental backdrop.

Specifically, Zcash mining economics also improved substantially as higher profitability attracted considerably greater network participation throughout 2026. 

Accordingly, Grayscale estimated Zcash miner rewards near $2 million daily, compared with roughly $35 million for Bitcoin miners. Despite the huge disparity, Zcash delivered nearly twice Bitcoin’s mining rewards per rig, according to Grayscale’s comparison. 

Additionally, the ZEC protocol also generated around four times Bitcoin’s rewards per megawatt-hour, improving its relative energy economics. This profitability helped explain why Zcash mining activity increased by more than 250% throughout 2026. 

The mining-power chart also  showed particularly rapid expansion during the latest phase of the year, thus complementing the demand-side developments.

ZEC’s fifth wave awaits confirmation

On the 24-hour chart at time press time, Zcash’s price structure had completed four stages of a developing Elliot impulse wave sequence, as Wave (5) awaited confirmation. 

Notably, wave (1) advanced towards the $850 region after breaking out of its consolidation range  before Wave (2) retraced towards the $813.95 support zone. 

The bulls then drove Wave (3) sharply higher, with the ZEC price reaching the $1,295–$1,298 resistance region. This third-wave impulse wave remained the strongest leg, satisfying a key condition for the developing motive structure.

Subsequently, wave (4) then pulled ZEC towards the $1,054.72 zone without overlapping the Wave (1) peak, protecting the bullish sequence. At press time, Zcash price had reversed to $1,138.89, as RSI cooled to 62.37 from the recent overbought conditions. 

The five-wave cycle, however, still needs Wave (5) confirmation, and a sustained advance above the $1,295–$1,298 supply zone would strengthen that confirmation and open a path to the $1,500 possible target. 

Alternatively, losing the $1,054.72 support would instead challenge the current wave count, and raise the risk of a truncated Elliott impulse wave. 

Final Summary

  • Whale accumulation and taker buying strengthened ZEC’s demand during its latest recovery.
  • ZEC’s developing Elliott impulse wave now awaits Wave 5 to confirm the bullish cycle structure.

data.title: SUI flashes KEY bullish signal – Can price push toward $0.84?
data.description:
Sui’s [SUI] 12-hour chart printed a fresh TD Sequential buy signal around $0.71, creating the possibility of a price reversal following the recent selling pressure.

Notably, the signal arrived as SUI attempted to stabilize after its latest price retracement toward a significant demand region. A crypto analyst highlighted the setup after the TD Sequential identified another potential shift on the 12-hour timeframe chart.

Importantly, the indicator’s previous signal preceded a 17% SUI price advance, giving the recent reading additional relevance. 

The historical reaction, therefore, strengthened the case for watching whether the bulls could regain control around the current price levels.

The signal alone, even so, did not confirm a sustained  price recovery. The bulls still needed price strength above nearby resistance before the reversal case could gain stronger confirmation.

Top traders lean heavily toward longs

The top traders’ positioning on the derivatives added another bullish factor to SUI’s developing recovery outlook. 

According to CoinGlass, the Binance Top Trader Long/Short Ratio showed 73.53% of long accounts as of writing, while shorts represented 26.47%.

The distribution produced a 2.78 Long/Short Ratio, suggesting a substantial imbalance towards the long positioning. Hence, the top traders maintained strong upside exposure as SUI attempted a price recovery back to the previous highs.

Furthermore, the positioning also aligned with the TD Sequential signal, creating agreement between trader sentiment and the technical reversal setup.

The heavy long positioning, however, also increased vulnerability to any renewed downside move. Any price breakdown around the current support could pressure the crowded longs and limit the developing recovery structure.

Can SUI complete its double bottom?

At the time of writing, SUI traded within its order block, where the bulls had previously triggered a strong reaction from the same region. Specifically, the order block earlier triggered a 17% rally from $0.7215 to $0.8440, confirming its importance as a demand zone. 

Interestingly, the analyst also noted that the previous TD Sequential signal preceded that rally, complementing the order block’s bullish reaction. SUI’s price later retraced toward the underlying fair value gap (FVG) around the $0.69 area after six consecutive red daily candles. 

However, the most recent session printed a green reversal candle as SUI rebounded towards the $0.7241 price level. Notably, the recovery maintained a potential double-bottom structure around the recent price lows. 

Additionally, the RSI indicator also reflected a bullish convergence during the rebound, strengthening the recovery narrative. A strong hold of the order block could likely support a move toward the $0.7771 area, followed by $0.8440 if the bulls strengthen.

Overhead liquidity favors an upside sweep 

SUI’s Binance Liquidation Heatmap showed liquidity on both sides, but the broader technical structure supported an upside move. 

Notably, considerable liquidity concentration stretched through the $0.73–$0.74 area, providing potential targets during continued buying.

On the technical side, SUI HAD rebounded from the FVG AROUND $0.69 while maintaining its developing double-bottom structure. Meanwhile, the latest green daily candle strengthened the recovery attempt after six consecutive bearish sessions. 

These signals supported continued buying toward the nearest upside liquidity concentrations around the $0.73–$0.74 zone. Besides, lower liquidation clusters also remained visible around the $0.70 and $0.68–$0.69 regions, although the demand structure limited their immediate pull. 

Ultimately, holding the order block would increase the chances of SUI sweeping overhead liquidity first. 

Such a price move could strengthen the recovery attempt towards the $0.7771 resistance. Beyond that resistance, persistent buying would potentially bring the $0.8440 supply zone back into focus. 

Final Summary

  • SUI’s double-bottom structure and fresh buy signal strengthened its developing recovery setup.
  • Preserving the order block could favor an upside liquidity sweep toward $0.7771.

data.title: PayPal crypto strategy expands as PYUSDx goes live with $100M
data.description:
Businesses are now launching tokens that are backed by PYUSD to their customers, allowing PayPal to branch out of its standard PayPal Digital Dollar currency.

PYUSDX moved into public launch with projects such as Saturn, Concrete, and Pay Cap, making use of the platform, and MoonPay claims it has now reached a $100 million AUM upon launch day, due to these projects.

PYUSD becomes the foundation for other tokens

PYUSDx enables firms to issue stablecoins and attach to the currency their names, rules, and use, and they are backed by PYUSD, which is designed to remain at $1.

By offering this level of control without requiring them to build out the underlying payment and reserve system, companies would be able to issue their own tokenized dollars, backed by PYUSD-based rails, rather than relying on building out their own system. 

PayPal first announced PYUSDx with MoonPay and M0 in February, and its September launch means that it has now entered public use with companies.

Saturn uses the infrastructure for USDat, Concrete has launched concUSD for its investment services, while Cap has moved part of its cUSD system onto the platform.

They mainly target lending, investments, and other onchain financial services instead of everyday retail payments.

PYUSDx comes with an important distinction

Even with the PayPal branding, PYUSDx is still run by MoonPay Digital Assets, and it makes use of technology from M0.

Tokens that are created through the platform are issued by MoonPay Digital Assets, not by PayPal or Paxos [the company behind PYUSD].

The stablecoin cannot also be held, sent, or received from PayPal and Venmo accounts at this time due to regulations. But these regulations depend on the company, token, and country, so availability may differ.

PYUSD is still central, as it is the asset backing these bespoke tokens, and this means that increased use of PYUSDx might lead to increased demand for PYUSD without every customer needing to hold PYUSD.

The platform supports Ethereum, Arbitrum, and Monad, while built-in conversion tools allow participants to change tokens without each project having to create a new liquidity pool.

Final Summary

  • PYUSDx has entered public use with $100 million in reported assets under management.
  • MoonPay issues the customized tokens with PayPal’s PYUSD as the backing.
